meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, language-native tooling, and optionally CodeGraph knowledge graph. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计代码库技术债，生成带修复优先级的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在清理代码库、规划重构或提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically audit technical debt and generate prioritized fix reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are cleaning up codebase, planning refactoring, or improving code quality

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 9 个维度扫描代码库,找出技术债问题,生成 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md 报告,标注文件位置、严重程度、预计工时和优先修复项。
howto.when: 当用户要求做技术债审计、代码健康检查、架构评审等,或提到「tech debt」「technical debt」「code health」等触发词时。

say.text: 帮我审计这个代码库的技术债,生成报告。
检查一下代码健康状况,标出需要优先修的债务。
say.note: Claude 会给出分级严重度和优先修复清单。

say.text: 做一次架构评审,列出高严重度的技术债问题。
say.note: 报告会包含按影响/工时排序的前 5 项优先事项。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude audits codebases across 9 dimensions using AST-grep, grep, and language-native tools, optionally with CodeGraph. It writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with file-cited findings, severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning, or says trigger words like 'tech debt' or 'code health'.

say_en.text: Audit this codebase for technical debt and generate a report.
Check codebase health and list the highest-priority debt items.
say_en.note: Returns findings with severity and effort estimates.

say_en.text: Run an architecture review and flag critical tech debt.
say_en.note: Top 5 priorities are ranked by impact over effort.
